title: Naming the sides from angle A
caption: From the angle at A: the hypotenuse is AB = 13, opposite the right angle; the opposite side is BC = 5, across from A; the adjacent side is AC = 12, the other side touching A.
alt: A right-angled triangle with the right angle at C, AC = 12 along the bottom, BC = 5 up the side and the hypotenuse AB = 13. The angle at A is marked.
description: The right angle is at C, with AC = 12 and BC = 5.
The hypotenuse AB = 13 is opposite the right angle.
Looking from angle A, the side across from it is BC = 5: the opposite.
The side next to A that is not the hypotenuse is AC = 12: the adjacent.
